ModMetadata.Name: ChatMod
ModMetadata.Author: TinyPanda
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ChatMod[/h1]
A modern chat overlay for Stationeers. Replaces the vanilla chat input with a persistent, draggable panel that supports message history, notification sounds, and auto-fade.
[h3]Features[/h3] [list] [*] Draggable chat panel with scrollable message history [*] HUD hotkey icon with unread message badge [*] Configurable auto-fade — panel fades out after inactivity [*] Notification sounds for incoming messages [*] Player name colors based on suit color [*] Host indicator icon on host messages [*] Console message capture (errors, actions, general output) [*] Fully configurable via BepInEx Configuration Manager [/list]
[h3]Installation[/h3] Subscribe on the Workshop and make sure BepInEx and StationeersLaunchPad are installed. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad

ModMetadata.ChangeLog:
[h3]Version 0.1.3:[/h3] [list] [*] Perf: Cache HUD hotkey clone marker — eliminates FindObjectsOfType scans (31ms → 0.005ms per call) [*] Fix: Reset caret position on clear — no more offset caret after sending long messages [*] Fix: Input field text viewport now correctly wired to TextArea (scroll follows caret while typing) [*] Fix: Immediate input focus when panel is already visible — no more dropped first character [*] Fix: F7 now closes the panel even while input field is focused, clears typed text [/list]
[h3]Version 0.1.2:[/h3] [list] [*] New: Chat panel auto-fade with configurable timeout (EnableAutoFade, AutoFadeTimeout) [*] New: Panel reopens on new message if it was auto-closed by fade [*] Fix: F7 / HUD icon toggle no longer auto-focuses the input field [*] Fix: Notification sound now bundled via prefab (no longer requires loose wav file) [/list]
[h3]Version 0.1.1:[/h3] [list] [*] Fix: Deduplicate messages on listen servers (host + client) [*] Fix: Cache notification sound clip to avoid repeated disk reads [*] Refactor: Complete codebase restructure — clean layer boundaries (Data, UI, Audio, Patches) [*] Refactor: ChatUiBehaviour + ChatUiBootstrap merged into ChatPanel [*] Refactor: Message rendering extracted to ChatMessageListView [*] Refactor: HotkeyHudClone consolidated (CloneMarker now private nested class) [*] Refactor: Removed dead code (ChatInputBar.Build, unused layout constants) [*] Refactor: Normalized namespaces and folder structure [*] Chore: Tightened .gitignore — removed game DLLs, TMP package, editor wizard from tracking [/list]
